item.title: Legitimacy in and out: Why local governments collaborate with researchers and how citizens respond
item.description: This paper combines a field experiment with municipal officials and a survey experiment with citizens to examine whether input and output legitimacy motivate local governments to collaborate with researchers and whether such collaboration increases citizens’ trust in government.

item.title: Is causal inference “observable” in public administration? A systemtic review
item.description: Reviewing 5,246 public administration articles from 2016 to 2025, we document how often and how well scholars use observational causal inference methods and offer propositions for using them to advance theory.
